summary: Steve Hilton, per Vote for Peace's reporting, supports U.S.-funded military aid to Israel and pledged legal action against California cities adopting BDS. He expressed optimism after Israel's 2025 strikes on Iranian nuclear sites and in a 2021 Fox appearance called the American left and media 'servants' for their Israel-Palestine coverage. In 2026 he told JNS that Democratic gubernatorial candidates ignore 'Jew-hatred,' framing the Gaza conflict as an anti-Semitism issue. Vote for Peace opposes his general-election bid.
